stem: Voltmarkt's display budget for Q3 was €8,000 in July, €10,000 in August and €12,000 in September. Actual spend was €7,600, €10,900 and €13,500. Voltmarkt computes variance % as 100 × (actual - budget) / budget, so over budget is positive. What was the variance % for Q3 as a whole? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
